walkthrough: Goal: a beginner opens OpenPaint for the first time and takes the first lesson: three short exercises that show how a lesson goes, nothing scored.

Entry: the first launch opens on the home: Practice beside the Studio (no artworks yet): Practice says its unit, Unit 1 · Lines and colours, and offers the next lesson, First lesson, 3 exercises, about 2 minutes, with Start; under a rule the unit's skills as small tiles, Lines, Combined lines and Colours, each with three empty dots; All units and Practice book at the foot.

Start: the day's sheet opens on its first row, labelled Lesson 1 · First lesson, the bar First lesson 1/3. The first lesson's How shows by itself: three numbered steps (scribble in the frame light then hard; copy the line on the left in the frame on the right; tap Compare, see where it is off, then Next) above a rule that nothing is scored here. Got it.
Exercise 1: a free scribble in one frame, a light stroke and a hard one; no Compare on it. Next.

Exercise 2, First lesson 2/3: a straight line on the left, an empty frame on the right; the How does not come again (it was read a moment ago). I copy the line and tap Compare: the original lies over my line in red, the pen turns to Correct; no Accurate, Almost or Again (nothing is scored on the first lesson). Next.
Exercise 3, First lesson 3/3: an arc; I copy it, Compare; the bar's last action is Finish.

Finish: the end. First lesson, 3 exercises and the time they took; no result marks; the First step seal; One more, under it what it starts: Lines, 6 exercises, about 5 min, on the next row of this sheet; That's all for today.
That's all for today: back on the home, which now offers Lines at Beginning with Start.

Cancel: Home on the sheet at any exercise leaves for the home; the home then names it (First lesson 2/3) and Continue opens it where it was (s122-path walks it). Undo takes back the strokes of the exercise shown only.
After a restart: the app opens on the same home, Lines next. The first lesson's sheet is in the practice book (s122-path).
